name: Elenfreet
source:
"We finally meet, my fated princess."

The prince of Stahl who holds the divine rights of the king. Behind his good looks and gentle way of speaking, he's actually ruthless and cruel. He can say brutal things in a soft tone, and he will do anything to reach his goal. He also justifies his actions and words as "justice" that resides within him.
